snippet.title: Ride through Yosemite Valley to Hike Bridal Veil Falls
snippet.description:
A group of us rode into Yosemite National Park the day before, but we were excited to see the natural beauty the park has to offer.

Bridal Veil Falls is a really easy hike about 0.5mi from where we parked. If you choose to climb over the railing it becomes more challenging.

Riding a motorcycle through a National Park is the best way to experience it and I hope you enjoy this video, but encourage y'all to get out there and experience it for yourself!

snippet.title: Let's Ride: Taking the scenic route to Solvang, CA from Los Angeles, CA
snippet.description:
Hey y'all I didn't really have a plan for this video I just wanted to take you along one of my favorite destination rides to Solvang, CA. This is a 290 mile round trip journey for me and the reason Corry and I make it is to get some of Birkholm Bakery's Florentine and Princess Waffle cookies.
The route we took to get to Solvang is:
1)Met at Patrick's Roadhouse on PCH (or the 1)
2) Take the 1 all the way north to Las Posas Rd and hop on the 101NB
3) Exit 101NB at 33 to Ojai
4) Make a left on to the 150
5) Make a right on to the 192 
6) Make a right on to the 154 and take it all the way to Solvang.

Let me know if you would like to see more of these scenic route videos on this channel AND if you've had a Florentine how much you love it.

snippet.title: Life on 2: Riding with Siggy
snippet.description: Hey y'all this is an edited video when me and my cousin Siggy went riding. It's mostly some random moments with me and Siggy on bikes and a little conversation about some of my favorite female UFC fighters. Finally, this video and the longer version that will follow it were the last videos I edited on my older software so that is why there is a change in these videos. Thank you guys for your continued support and as usual lemme know what you think below!!!

snippet.title: Life on 2: With Dirty Diana
snippet.description: Hey y'all thanks for your patience and your continued love and support. Like I said I'm always trying to improve and evolve this channel so this is the next step in this journey and I encourage all of you to follow me through my journey of this Life on 2.
